content:
The genome refers to the complete set of genetic material (DNA) in an organism, including all of its genes and non-coding sequences.  
Option (A) refers to chromosome count, not the genome itself.  
Option (B) correctly defines the genome as the entire DNA sequence of an organism.  
Option (C) describes the proteome, not the genome.  
Option (D) describes only part of the genome (one chromosome), not the whole.  

Final answer: (B)
